whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.body: GO TREX for Export is a leading Egyptian company specialized in exporting a wide range of food industry products. Based in Egypt, we serve as a trusted partner for clients seeking premium food products sourced and processed under the highest standards. We are committed to reliability, consistency, and building long-term partnerships that deliver value across international markets.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: To deliver high-quality Egyptian food products to global markets while building long-term partnerships based on trust, quality, and mutual growth.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.body: To become one of the most recognized and respected food export companies in the Middle East and Africa, expanding into new international markets with a commitment to excellence and sustainability.

quality.title: Quality
quality.desc: Ensuring international food safety standards in every product we export.
